words.word: it me with such a reward

occurrences.text: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
words: it me with such a reward

occurrences.text: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.
